rootCauses.workerFatalAndSilentResponse: ActualSDKrequests and later manualdecode retry stay pending; worker registers only onmessage, without error/deadline recovery.
rootCauses.idle1000ms: Not a proven decode-cancellation cause. Official useWorkers(0) queues emptyclose behind pending decode; actual decoder test completes both jobs exactly and terminatecount stays0.
rootCauses.idleTemporaryOverlap: A later SDK request before the closing worker drains can create another physical worker; owned supervisor retires only when it has no active/queued jobs.

implementation.decoder: Originalcontent-addressed pinned script imported inside classicworker; real WASMdecodeGltfBuffer used; nestedworkers0.
implementation.globalOwnership: Existing external MeshoptCompression._Default is preserved without dispose/reset; diagnosticstatus external. Only install when Default is absent.
implementation.nonrenewingDeadline: Queue/init/decode transitions never renew total45s.44sinit+1sdecode timesout,not44+44.
implementation.failure: First triggering job/stage retained; all waiters fail once; failedlatch blocks newjobs; no automatic failedjob replay.
implementation.recovery: Only explicit initializeVillageMeshopt re-entry clears owned failedlatch. Next request creates a cleanworker.
implementation.healthySharing: No map AbortSignal/engine/scene ownership is held by decode API. One map stopping its await cannot terminate a healthy shared job or another caller.
implementation.input: One copy only when queuedjob is sent; callercompressed buffer is never detached.
implementation.result: No quality conversion. Returned decoded bytes pass to normal Babylon glTF/accessor paths and existing bounded geometry decodecache.

lifecycle.scope: Module/page-level decoder because SDKdecode API has no engine argument.
lifecycle.normalIdle: Owned WASM worker terminates after1s only when active/queue areempty.
lifecycle.shutdown: Explicit owned adapter.dispose releasesworker,pendingjobsandblobURL; never automatically invoked on individualmap/engine cancellation.
lifecycle.retainedBetweenIdleUses: One small BlobURL/functionfactory+bounded diagnosticrecords remain until explicit dispose/documentteardown; no scene,material,textureorengine retained.
lifecycle.externalModeLimit: An already external poisoneddecoder is not repaired behind its ownerback; preserving externalsharedwork is intentional. Workerlessmode is reported and leaves SDK behavior unchanged.

realPinnedWasm.scope: Actual pinned decoder worker body+WASM over Node WebWorker API adapter, no browser/device/GPU claim.

limits: Injected failure scenarios and actual WASM decoding use isolatedVM/NodeWorker APIadapters,not browserautomation or physicaldevice observations.
A legitimate decode takinglongerthan45s is also rejected; this is a boundedfailurepolicy,notspeedupclaimevidence.
